review_scope: Exact five newly delivered postrun files only; unchanged production source is used as a pinned helper parent, not re-reviewed as a new production candidate. No live S64 result metadata or payload was read.

findings.detail: Full fixed S40 readback source is SHA-checked before AST extraction. Only pure Reader/descriptor/hash/trace definitions, WIDTHS/FIELDS, and run statements from groups at line261 onward are selected. Exactly one top-level five-image cross-cache RGB loop is omitted; other numerical statements remain unchanged. The wrapper removes the inapplicable trace-blob counter from the returned report. The fixed S64 collect_unit_receipts function is extracted unchanged; S40 main/full-archive payload sweep and old terminal entry are not run.

findings.item: Actual three-SHA terminal binding precedes scientific payload
findings.detail: Runtime requires supplied actual manifest, external receipt and terminal-commit hashes; none is invented or hardcoded as a future result. Fixed S64 paths, external argv/supervisor PID/zero return/no timeout, parent/worker/watchdog and commit hashes/statuses, source identities, no failure receipts, consumption binding, current directory identities and actual unit-call receipt hashes are checked before archive numerical arrays. Runtime/loading variant and original-cohort exclusion must agree. Root will independently review the real complete terminal before using these inputs.

Captures are located by names and occurrence rather than copied V9 sequence numbers. Original trace state machine requires two closed batches. New call ordering requires first map commit before render input/output/retrieval and second context return. Existing numerical block checks valid distinct measured IDs, history1/5/9, retained IDs1..8, true cache-to-context rows, get_cond arguments, camera/K/translation chain, condition-to-sampler tensors, sampled latent and real image-encoder output to retained cache, and50 Euler calls in each batch. The second selection must contain four actual legal IDs; no B0/S63 fixed ID answer is used.

SelectiveReader verifies each used event descriptor against the archive descriptor and file table, then hashes descriptor identity and actual body before lazy array access. Fully verified payloads are deduplicated by resolved full path and logged with SHA/size/dtype/shape. FP32 samples, encode_image input and retained uint8 pixel payloads are classified as RGB bodies even without a codec/display. Unique verified file bytes are reported separately from RGB verified bytes and explicitly are not physical I/O counts.

Pinned old V9 partial archive remains partial. The27 first-occurrence fields are noise, samples_z/samples, five entries of each four cache types and four retained pixel arrays. Both sides are descriptor/body-verified even if declared identities differ; actual differences are included as booleans in the report and do not affect engineering PASS or trigger retries. Metadata timestamps/event-chain hashes are not treated as prefix content equality.

findings.item: Once-only bounded readback and evidence limits
findings.detail: Fresh output directory, inherited300-second reader limit, immutable source identities and before-seal input signatures are enforced. Main retains failed/partial receipt on run-stage errors; root external wrapper owns source-load/process-layer failure evidence. No model/renderer/get_cond recomputation, original image/weight/GT read, PNG/image display or quality scoring is in the selected path. Unselected archive bodies are inventory/size-only, not claimed verified.

actual_run.read_scope: Fixed S40 source and S64 launcher source only. No S64 result metadata/tensors/RGB; no derived helper execution or run/terminal call.

compile_only_check.scope: One source-only compile route, not terminal/readback execution or synthetic/real scientific test.

actual_reviewer_reads.old_metadata_scope: Old V9 external/parent/worker/watchdog receipt schemas checked against selected terminal field names; no old scientific payload bodies.

limits: This source PASS cannot establish that the still-running S64 has completed or that any live/future terminal payload is valid.
The selected old numerical comparisons verify saved consumption consistency; they do not recompute the mathematical correctness of model, renderer, get_cond or RNG state.
Actual RGB body access will end any content-unseen status for those future fields; the script does not claim0RGB simply because it does not display images.
No additional test matrix, safety framework or approval state was introduced; original source and old records remain unchanged.
